verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to tz'awtaj masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yik wach' smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh yet' winh.

Ayik ix jawi heb' winh, ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh, heb' winh sakerdote, heb' winh schekab' Dios yet' masanil heb' komon anima, heb' malaj wal yelk'ochi yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a stemplo Jehová. Ata' ix yal winh rey chi' to a ch'anh yumal strato Jehová ix chax t'a stemplo, tz'awtaj ch'anh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi'.

Ix och tek'tek' winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy, ix yak'an sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to ol sk'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il winh yet' k'ayb'ub'al t'a smasanil sk'ool, icha syal jun trato tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yol ch'anh uum chi'. Anheja' masanil heb' anima chi', ix yak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh sat sakerdote aj Hilcías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh stanhwan spuertail templo to syik'elta heb' winh masanil tastak ay t'a yol stemplo Jehová, haton yamk'ab' sk'an heb' anima yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Baal, t'a Asera yet' t'a k'een k'anal. Ix yik'el heb' winh t'a stiel chonhab' Jerusalén, ix snhusantz'a heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix lajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at staanhil t'a Betel.

Ix yik'anel yopisio heb' winh sakerdote winh rey chi', haton heb' winh snhusantz'a inkienso b'aj chaanh t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a stitak chonhab' Jerusalén, haton heb' winh ak'b'il yopisio yuj heb' winh rey ek'nak. Ix ik'chajpaxel heb' winh sakerdote snhusantz'a inkienso t'a Baal, t'a k'u, t'a k'een uj, t'a k'een k'anal yet' t'a juntzanh niwak k'anal sb'eyek' t'a satcha'anh.

Ix yik'anpaxel jun yechel Asera winh rey chi', haton jun ayoch t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Ix b'at yak'ankan heb' t'a stiel chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix nhuschajtz'a t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix stenanchojok stanhil chi' winh, ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh b'aj mukan heb' komon anima.
Ix pojjipaxem juntzanh yet'tal heb' winh ix-winak yuj winh, haton b'ob'il t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Ata' sch'alwipax heb' ix ix sb'oan k'apak mantiado yik Asera.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh sakerdote winh rey chi', haton heb' winh ay t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yixtanb'at masanil altar winh t'a masanil lugar chaanh t'a Geba masanto t'a Beerseba, haton b'aj snhustz'a inkienso juntzanh heb' winh sakerdote. Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh, juntzanh ay t'a spuertail chonhab' skan t'a stojolal sk'exan mach tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi', haton jun puerta yik winhaj Josué yajal t'a Jerusalén.

Ha heb' winh sakerdote yinhtilal Leví ix ak'an silab' t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh, majxo k'ochlaj heb' winh t'a altar yik Jehová t'a Jerusalén, axonhej swael heb' winh tz'ak'ji yuj heb' winh yetsakerdoteal chi'.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at jun lugar winh rey chi', jun skuchan Tofet t'a sch'olanil Ben-hinom b'aj snhusjitz'a heb' unin silab'il t'a jun komon Dios skuchan Moloc, yik manhxa junok mach sk'ulan jun chukal chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxel nok' chej winh, nok' ayoch yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá yik tz'och ejmelal t'a k'u. Ix snhusantz'a skarruaje nok' chej chi' winh. Ha juntzanh chi', ha t'a jun amak' t'a slak'anil b'aj tz'och anima t'a yol stemplo Jehová, ata' ay, t'a stz'ey skuarto jun winh ay yopisio skuchan Natán-melek.

Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh rey chi', juntzanh b'ob'ilkan yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá t'a spanhanil yib'anh skuartokan winhaj rey Acaz. Ay pax juntzanh altar b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Manasés t'a chab' yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová, ix smak'poj winh, ix syumankanb'at sk'ajil winh t'a yol ha' Cedrón.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at juntzanh lugar winh, juntzanh chaanh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Jerusalén, t'a stojolal sur t'a tzalan Oliwo, haton jun sb'onakkan winhaj Salomón sreyal Israel, haton Astarté sdiosal heb' aj Sidón, Quemos sdiosal heb' moabita yet' Milcom sdiosal heb' amonita. Masanil juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Ix smak'anpaxpoj k'een k'een winh, k'een chajul yaj t'a heb' anima, ix ch'akchajpaxel te' yechel Asera. Ix saklemajb'at sb'akil chamnak ta' yuj winh.

Ix smak'paxpoj jun altar winh yet' templo t'a Betel, haton sb'onakkan winhaj rey Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Pokokxonhej ix aji, ix snhusantz'a yechel Dios Asera chi' winh.

Ix ek' k'elelok winhaj Josías chi', ix yilanb'at juntzanh yet'tal chamnak winh t'a jun tzalan, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'chajelta sb'akil chamnak ayoch t'a yool chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yik tz'ixtaxb'ati. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan jun winh schekab' Jehová t'a peka'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Josías chi': --¿Mach ay yik jun yet'tal chamnak swilb'at chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' kajan t'a Betel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Haton b'aj mukan jun winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Judá, a winh aljinakkan yuj tas ix utej jun altar t'a Betel tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Aktejekkani, malaj junok mach syaman sb'akil chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' majxo yamjilaj sb'akil jun winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' sb'akil junxo winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Samaria.

Icha ix yutej winhaj Josías chi' t'a Betel chi', icha pax chi' ix yutej winh satanel juntzanh lugar chaanh, juntzanh b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi' yuj heb' winh sreyal Israel, juntzanh stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar ix smilcham masanil heb' winh sakerdote winh, haton heb' winh yik juntzanh lugar chaanh t'a Samaria chi'. Ix snhusantz'a sb'akil juntzanh chamnak winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxta winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Josías t'a masanil heb' chonhab' icha tik: Kak'ekoch q'uinh yik sko naankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto yik skik'anchaanh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal, icha syalkan t'a yumal trato, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix och jun q'uinh chi'. Yiktax ix lajwiek' stiempoal heb' juez, heb' ix ak'an yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel, malaj junelok ix och jun q'uinh icha jun chi' t'a stiempoal heb' winh ix ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Israel.
Yik wal 18 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal ix och jun q'uinh chi' t'a Jerusalén, yuj yik'jichaanh Jehová.

Masanil heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak, heb' ajb'aal yet' juntzanh yechel t'a yoltak pat, ix satjiel yuj winhaj Josías chi'. Masanil pax juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak ay t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a yol smakb'en Judá ix satel winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yik sk'anab'ajan winh tas syalkan t'a yumal ley ix chax yuj winhaj sakerdote Hilcías t'a yol stemplo Jehová.

Malaj junokxo rey ek'nakxo ix sk'ex spensar yik syak'anoch sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová t'a smasanil sk'ool, t'a smasanil spensar yet' t'a smasanil yip, icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Josías chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej winh tas alb'ilkan t'a ley Moisés. Manhxalaj pax junokxo rey icha chi' ix yutej sb'a.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh, palta yuj tas te chuk sk'ulejnak winhaj Manasés, yuj chi' aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Judá chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ol wik'el Judá t'a wichanh, icha wutejnak Israel. Ol in patikejkanel Jerusalén, jun chonhab' sik'b'ilel wuuj yet' jun templo tik, jun walnak yuj to a t'ay tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, xchi.

Ha t'a stiempoal chi' ix kot winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado yik sb'at heb' t'a ha' niwan Éufrates, yik sb'at kolwaj winh yet' winh sreyal Asiria. Ix b'at winhaj rey Josías yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winhaj Necao chi' t'a Meguido. Ayik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh t'a owal chi', ix miljicham winhaj Josías chi' yuj winh. Ix ak'jik'e sniwanil winh t'a yol karruaje yuj heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Meguido chi' masanto ix jawi heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix ak'jikanoch sniwanil winh chi' t'a jun yet'tal b'ob'ilxo. Axo heb' anima smasanil t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josías chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha winhaj Joacaz chi', 23 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Jerusalén. Oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal chi' winh. Hamutal sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Jeremías aj Libna.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.

Ix ak'jioch winh t'a preso yuj winhaj rey Necao t'a Ribla t'a yol yik Hamat, yik wach' maxtzak yak' yajalil winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yak'anoch k'een tumin winhaj Necao chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi', 75 kintal k'een plata yet' oxe' arroba k'een oro.

Axo winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Josías chi' ix yak'och winhaj rey Necao chi' reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Ix sk'exan sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' winh, Joacim ix sb'iej winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Joacaz chi' winh t'a Egipto. Ata' ix cham winhaj Joacaz chi'.

Ix yak'an k'een oro winhaj Joacim chi' yet' k'een plata sk'an winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'och k'een winh t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a yol smakb'en chi', junjun anima ix yak' k'een oro yet' k'een plata, icha tastak ay t'a junjun heb'. Icha chi' ix aj smolan k'een tumin winh ix kan t'a yib'anh chi'.
Ha winhaj Joacim chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Zebu sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Pedaías aj Ruma.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.
